role: Protagonist of the Opsly Universe — represents Cristian, never fully unmasked

visual.silhouette_prompt: Human figure partially augmented by technology, hooded cloak, face obscured by a mask of luminous geometric lines, one mechanical arm built from visible circuitry, traveler's gear layered with tech

face.eye_style: never fully shown — glowing geometric lines suggest expression through light intensity and pattern shift, not literal eyes
face.mouth_style: hidden beneath hood/mask at all times — emotion carried by posture and voice, never facial expression
expressions: determination (pattern sharpens into a single point)

clothing.primary: long hooded traveler's coat, worn fabric layered over a partially mechanical body
accessories: layered wraps at wrists and boots

mechanical_elements: right arm: exposed circuitry and joints built up over many journeys, not a single clean prosthetic — visibly patched and evolved over time
mask: geometric light-line pattern projected across the hidden face
boots and greaves: layered mechanical plating mixed with worn travel gear
visual.generation_prompt: A hooded human traveler in a vast cosmic city, face fully obscured by a mask of glowing geometric light-lines, one arm visibly mechanical and built from exposed, weathered circuitry, wearing a long worn coat over layered tech gear with sacred-geometry symbols stitched into the fabric, standing amid floating constellations and digital architecture, contemplative posture, cinematic wide shot
visual.negative_prompt: do not show the face or eyes under any circumstance, no clean/shiny superhero armor, no symmetrical unblemished mechanical parts, no confident heroic pose — keep posture humble and searching, not triumphant

voice.tone: low, warm, searching — a narrator thinking out loud more than performing
voice.sample_line: Pensé que estaba perdido. Después entendí que estaba construyendo el mapa.

prohibited_variations: never reveal the face or eyes, in any episode, any angle, any lighting
do not make the mechanical arm symmetrical, clean, or unscarred — it must read as built up over time, imperfect
do not pose The Traveler as an invincible hero — always some visual sign of uncertainty, wear, or smallness against the world around him
do not change the hooded silhouette to an unhooded one
do not drop the sacred-geometry mask pattern
